2.  Recommendation that the city council consider adopting Resolution No. 022­2026, placing a
  business license tax measure on the November 3, 2026 General Municipal Election ballot.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 022­2026
  calling for the placement of a general tax measure on the November 3, 2026 General Municipal
  Election ballot for the submission to the qualified voters of a proposed ordinance amending
  section 5.04.100 of Chapter 5.04 and various sections of articles I and II of Chapter 5.06 of the
  City’s municipal code as it relates to business license taxes; requesting the County of Los Angeles
  to consolidate said election with the Statewide General Election of even date; and setting rules and
  deadlines for arguments and rebuttals for and against the measure.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Del Rio spoke.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, spoke.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, spoke.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Councilmember De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember De Paula, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 022­2026, calling for the placement of a general tax
  measure on the November 3, 2026 General Municipal Election ballot for the submission to the
  qualified voters of a proposed ordinance amending section 5.04.100 of Chapter 5.04 and various
  sections of articles I and II of Chapter 5.06 of the City’s municipal code as it relates to business
  license taxes; requesting the County of Los Angeles to consolidate said election with the
  Statewide General Election of even date; setting rules and deadlines for arguments and rebuttals
  for and against the measure; authorizing Mayor Del Rio and Councilmember Farfan to prepare,
  sign, and timely file the ballot argument in favor of the measure on the ballot; and authorize the
  same individuals to prepare and file a rebuttal argument if one becomes necessary.

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced the dates for two upcoming events: July 29­Ice Cream
with a Deputy; and August 4­National Night Out.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, reported that Public Works staff painted all locations regarding
the AB 413 daylighting law; and provided an update on the citywide Curb Address Project.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced that they will start using an online
development application (OpenGov) on August 3rd.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Roa reported that he attended the ICA conference.

Councilmember Farfan reported that he attended the ICA conference.

Councilmember De Paula reported that he attended the ICA conference.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting in memory of former Mayor Leonard Chaidez at 7:08 PM to the
next Regular City Council meeting to be held on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
